name: Aelnir Countdown
seoTitle: Aelnir Countdown: days counter with widgets and reminders
summary: Countdowns and count-ups for life events, with home-screen widgets, reminders and share cards.
tagline: Count down to the days that matter, or up from the ones that did. Widgets, reminders and share cards, with no account.

features.title: Make every day count
features.lead: Your events live on your phone and widgets keep them in view.

items.title: Countdowns and count-ups
items.body: Days until a trip, a birthday or an exam, or days since a day worth remembering.

items.title: Home-screen widgets
items.body: Pin a single event or a list to your home screen.

items.title: Reminders
items.body: Get notified before an event, with reminders that survive a restart.

items.title: Repeating events
items.body: Birthdays and anniversaries come back every year without setting them again.

items.title: Share cards
items.body: Turn a countdown into a card to send to friends.

items.title: Occasion themes and archive
items.body: Themes for every occasion, and an archive for events that have passed.

strip.label: Includes
strip.text: Countdown · Count-up · Widgets · Reminders · Repeats · Share cards · Archive

note.label: Offline
note.title: Your events never leave your phone
note.body: Aelnir Countdown needs no account and keeps your events on your phone.

privacy.headline: Your events never leave your phone.
privacy.lead: The app needs no account and has no server. Your events, reminders and settings are kept on your device. This version shows no ads and contains no advertising or analytics SDK.

studioProof.hard: Pure time and recurrence engines, with alarm chains and a safety-net worker so reminders still fire.
